name: Vessel fill and pour

source.description: An inspected recipe animation pours liquids into a glass: a stream from a tilted bottle and a rising, tinting liquid level with measurement ticks.

technique: A container fills as a pour stream connects bottle and liquid; the level rises against measurement ticks and the colour mixes with each ingredient, so quantities become visible.
purpose: Recipes, mixing, quantities and accumulation metaphors.
visual_behaviour: Bottle tilts about its neck, a stream draws down, the liquid level rises with a gently wavy surface and shifts colour, the stream retracts.
mechanics: Liquid as a wave path clipped by the vessel interior; level tween with ease-out; fill colour tween per ingredient; stream as a stroked path drawn then erased.

implementation.approach: Studio.draw.wave inside an SVG clipPath shaped like the vessel interior; level and fill tweens; Studio.draw.stroke / erase for the stream. Candidate Studio.fx.fill for the recipe templates (masala-chai project could use it).

provenance.observed: Bottles tilt and pour; the glass fills and changes colour against side ticks (approx., from overview spacing).

licensing_notes: Technique only; the reference drink and its bottles are not reproduced.
